parsed_json.up: Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units. Join activities with assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id. Join assays with target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid. Join activities with molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno. Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_type in ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50'), activities.standard_value < 50. Return distinct rows. Sort by activity_id ascending. Limit 200.
